_comment: Centrally governed KPI glossary (SRS 8.1). Every dashboard measure references one of these definitions.

kpis.definition: Occupied sellable room nights / Available sellable room nights
kpis.exclusions: Out-of-order rooms are excluded from available rooms. No-shows and cancellations are not sold rooms.

kpis.definition: Room revenue / Rooms sold
kpis.exclusions: Net of discounts, excluding taxes and service charge. Converted to USD at the arrival-date rate.

kpis.definition: Room revenue / Available sellable room nights
kpis.exclusions: Same revenue basis as ADR.

kpis.definition: Total operating revenue less operating expenses under the approved accounting definition
kpis.exclusions: General ledger basis. Excludes depreciation, interest, tax and management fees.

kpis.definition: GOP / Available room nights
kpis.exclusions: Same basis as GOP.

kpis.definition: Net sales / Covers or guests served
kpis.exclusions: Net of discounts, excluding taxes and service charge.

kpis.definition: Cost of food and beverage sold / Net food and beverage sales
kpis.exclusions: Recipe cost at time of sale.

kpis.definition: Covers served / (Seats x planned turns per day)
kpis.exclusions: Planned turns are set per outlet in the outlet master.

kpis.definition: Net sales / Number of transactions
kpis.exclusions: Net of discounts.

kpis.definition: Cost of goods sold / Average inventory
kpis.exclusions: Annualised from the selected period.

kpis.definition: Store-SKU days with zero stock on hand / Total store-SKU days
Actual utilisation / Available capacity
kpis.exclusions: Hourly ride capacity during operating hours.

kpis.definition: Daily visitors / Licensed daily park capacity
Booked service hours / Available service hours
kpis.formula: sum(completed duration) / (therapists x 10 operating hours x days)
kpis.exclusions: Completed appointments only.

kpis.definition: Attributable acquisition expenditure / Acquired customers
kpis.exclusions: Campaign media spend only.

kpis.definition: Incremental attributable return relative to campaign investment
kpis.exclusions: Attributed revenue is the incremental share reported by the marketing platform.

kpis.definition: Actual expenditure less budgeted expenditure
kpis.exclusions: Month-to-date budget is pro-rated by elapsed days.

kpis.definition: % promoters (9-10) minus % detractors (0-6) from post-stay surveys
kpis.exclusions: Post-stay survey respondents only.

kpis.definition: Total revenue from every outlet / Available sellable room nights
kpis.exclusions: Rooms, restaurants, waterpark, retail and spa revenue, net of discounts. Same available-room basis as RevPAR.

kpis.definition: Guest Satisfaction Score: share of surveyed guests rating their overall satisfaction 4 or 5 out of 5
kpis.exclusions: Post-stay survey responses only; guests who did not answer are excluded.

kpis.definition: Complaints logged by guest relations per 100 checked-out stays
kpis.exclusions: Complaints are counted on the day they are logged; stays on their departure date. Cancelled and no-show bookings are excluded.

kpis.definition: Spa revenue / Hours of completed treatments
kpis.exclusions: Completed appointments only. Cancelled and no-show appointments earn nothing and use no hours.

kpis.definition: (Retail sales - Cost of goods sold) / Retail sales
kpis.exclusions: Net of discounts. Cost of goods at purchase cost.

kpis.definition: Attributed revenue / Campaign spend
kpis.exclusions: Attributed revenue is the incremental share reported by the marketing platform.

kpis.definition: Cost per occupied room: Rooms department operating cost / Rooms sold
kpis.formula: sum(GL expense, Rooms cost centre) / sum(rooms_sold)
kpis.exclusions: Rooms payroll, operating supplies and distribution commissions. Excludes undistributed costs.

kpis.definition: Payroll cost / Total operating revenue
kpis.exclusions: All departments. General ledger basis.

kpis.definition: Energy and water cost / Total operating revenue
kpis.exclusions: General ledger basis.

kpis.definition: GOP / Total operating revenue
kpis.exclusions: Same basis as GOP.
